notes: All prices are numeric dollar amounts in United States dollars.
Winter is November 1 through April 30, inclusive.
Summer is May 1 through October 31, inclusive.
The season is determined from the reservation arrival date.
If a reservation or weekend overlaps Winter and Summer, use the season associated with the arrival date.
A two-day weekend means Friday night and Saturday night, with departure on Sunday.
A three-day weekend means Friday night, Saturday night, and Sunday night, with departure on Monday.
Weekend rates are available only for the Friday/Saturday or Friday/Saturday/Sunday night patterns described above.
A person is considered an adult for pricing purposes at age 18 or older.
A junior is age 6 until the person turns 18.
A child is under the age of 6.
Member Child or Guest Child pricing is selected based on the accompanying adult's status.
The source information spells 'Defined' as 'Defeined' for the child category; this JSON uses the corrected spelling.
